name: TLS fragment + fingerprint
description: Automatically adds fingerprint (fp), cipher suites (cs) and fragment mask (fm) to every TLS config — matches Proxy Builder's Fragment+Fingerprint tool.
details: Works ONLY on configs with `security=tls` (VLESS/Trojan TLS/WSS). Reality and non-TLS configs are untouched.
Three controls apply to the generated config string:
- fp : TLS fingerprint sent by the client (default: unsafe)
- cs : colon-separated cipher suite list (optional — leave empty to skip)
- fm : xray fragment mask as JSON (optional — leave empty to skip)
This is the same logic as the Proxy Builder's 'Fragment + Fingerprint' tool, but applied automatically at runtime.
How to build fm: copy the exact JSON output from Proxy Builder → Fragment+tab → paste it into `fm` below.
